title: Blizzard risk in Arunachal Pradesh
subject: Environment
caption: Blizzard risk map for Arunachal Pradesh showing temperature and wind conditions that trigger blizzards.
altText: A textbook‑style map on a white background that highlights Arunachal Pradesh in a pastel shade. The map uses a blue‑to‑white color gradient to show temperatures ranging from -20 °C (dark blue) to 0 °C (light blue). Overlaid are black arrows indicating wind direction and speed, with arrows thicker than 30 km/h highlighted in red. Contour lines depict pressure systems, and a legend explains the temperature colors, wind symbols, and a scale bar. Major rivers, mountain ranges, and towns are clearly labelled, providing an accurate visual representation of the climatic factors that contribute to blizzard risk in the region.
